caption:
A star on the door

Cella left a small star on the door and walked away.

Kindness tends to land harder than the giver expects: people underestimate how much a small, unexpected gesture means to the one who gets it.

Send it to the friend who leaves small surprises without signing them.

#Cella #habits

alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. A stairwell with a closed door on the right. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes walks up to it, glances left to check nobody is watching, then leans toward the door and a small golden star appears on it. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. Then it tiptoes back to the left, looks over at the star one more time and smiles.
